title: Charge Coupled 8-Bit Shift Register
lineage: Publisher-hosted abstract and publication metadata, also checked against the publisher’s Crossref deposit. The complete article was inaccessible.

passages.note: The Bell Labs authors report an eight-stage device with 26 closely spaced MOS capacitors and p–n junctions at both ends. In register mode a p–n junction injects charge and clocked electrodes transfer it. The abstract reports a separate operation as a line imager. It gives a publication date of 1 August 1970.
